informal_statement: Let G=(V,E) be a finite tree. Then |E| = |V| - 1.
hypotheses: G is a finite simple undirected tree, i.e., a finite simple graph, connected and acyclic
V is the vertex set of G
E is the edge set of G
proof_path: Formalize induction on |V| using finiteness; Define or use removal of a leaf vertex and the corresponding edge; Invoke or prove existence of a leaf in any finite tree; Apply induction hypothesis to G' = G - v; Do arithmetic manipulation to yield |E| = |V| - 1
fallback_path: Search for alignment with SimpleGraph.IsTree.card_edgeFinset or similar mathlib theorem
next_action: Audit mathlib for (1) the precise definition of SimpleGraph.IsTree, (2) its edge/vertex removal functions, and (3) a lemma ensuring the existence of a leaf in any finite tree.
